conclusion: The organic closed-trunk repair should first accept complete raw printed-material coverage without repeating lateral morphology, then use exact bounded working-set reuse and revision/locality checks to avoid repeated full-layer morphology. Ordered hierarchical road bounds eliminate per-point segment-list allocation and reject distant ranges while preserving the original rounded projection and tie order. Expanded axis-aligned BoundingBox values must be marked defined before merges. On the supplied input, the prior Release measured 573.096 seconds and the final isolated repetition measured 255.818 seconds; baseline build overlap is disclosed in evidence. Both supplied project outputs and 16 nozzle/fill/independent-height variants retain exact canonical commands and effective settings. Cache-disabled output agrees, and relevant native controls pass. Previously verified closed circuits and actual bead bearing are retained through exact output identity, with all prior physical/all-model limits. Optional cache allowance remains live-memory-aware and bounded; no printer-name or model-specific rule is introduced.
scope: Current uncommitted source and source-bound normal Release verification. Historical full suites, upstream observations and physical printing claims are not renewed.
